title: Owner-authorized minimal Dune execution smoke for daily macro data
objective: Execute the smallest possible owner-authorized DuneSQL smoke and one completed-day Bitcoin metric blueprint to validate Dune response/execution metadata before implementing the collector.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized use of the existing Dune credential for the daily macro workflow.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, copy, store, or expose credential values.
Do not create, update, archive, or share a saved Dune query or dashboard; use only query run-sql.
Do not execute any query outside SELECT 1 and the exact completed-day BTC transaction-count blueprint in this task.
Do not write to PostgreSQL, retain raw Dune payloads, send Hermes/Feishu, or start a schedule.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood adapters, collectors, webhooks, backfills, trading, signing, or execution capability.
deliverables: A sanitized run report containing SQL SHA-256, execution identifier/state if returned, result checksum, source-as-of observation time, row count, and the aggregate BTC value only.
A clear GREEN/PARK/FAIL verdict for the Dune response contract.
acceptance_commands: dune query run-sql --sql "SELECT 1 AS smoke_ok" --output json
